editorial.blurb: Evergreen is Chinatown's oldest Chinese restaurant, serving satisfying classic dishes like tender beef short ribs with black pepper sauce and flavorful egg tofu with pea tips.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the beef short ribs with black pepper sauce or egg tofu with pea tips — both come highly recommended by staff — and expect generous portions at $18–$19 per dish; service is quick, but be prepared for street parking only.
signatureDishes: Beef short ribs with black pepper sauce
